sentence: This project builds an introductory course on wireless communications that uses project-based learning and visualization tools.
This project builds course modules that teach cybersecurity and privacy to Criminal Justice professionals.
This project acquires a high-speed 3D imaging microscope to watch how soft materials move and change shape in real time.
This project develops methods that let teams of autonomous systems make decisions together while using limited communication.
This project acquires a testing framework that checks power and energy systems from single components up to full systems.
This project builds an open, adaptive framework for communication among satellites, unmanned aerial vehicles, and ground systems.
This project builds computer tools that learn from the molecular structure of peptides to predict their properties and help design them.
This project builds a tool that uses generative AI to make synthetic populations that combine people, the built environment, and behavior.
This project studies how a coral reef fish recognizes and picks a specific luminous bacterium as its partner.
This project builds an online certificate program in quantum computing that teaches quantum algorithms through real-world problems.
This project builds a mathematical foundation to explain why deep reinforcement learning works, using ideas from approximation theory, control theory, and optimization theory.
This project tests whether a single atom, interacting with light in a waveguide, can perform complex computations using memory effects.
This project studies whether meltwater reaching the base of the Antarctic Ice Sheet changes how fast the ice flows.
This project expands an open-source software platform that simulates how light drives the motion of electrons and energy in molecules and materials.
This project studies whether a software platform that runs artificial intelligence programs on mobile devices can support computer vision tasks with little computing power.
This project tries to find ways to classify algebras that come from groups by using rigidity, where limited information reveals the whole structure.
This project builds a network of unmanned aerial vehicles with imaging sensors that helps first responders monitor incidents.
